repos.summary_zh: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的开源命令行视频音频下载工具，支持数千个网站。它提供丰富的格式选择、元数据修改、字幕下载及强大的后处理能力，是跨平台媒体抓取与自动归档的终极利器。
repos.summary_en: yt-dlp is a highly feature-rich command-line audio and video downloader supporting thousands of global websites. It offers powerful format selection, extensive post-processing options like metadata modification and subtitle downloading, and robust cross-platform capabilities, making it the ultimate tool for automated media retrieval and archiving.

repos.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.
repos.summary_zh: Czkawka/Krokiet 是一款基于 Rust 的多功能跨平台桌面应用，专注于快速查找并清理系统中的重复文件、空文件夹、相似图片及临时文件等。它拥有高效的多线程算法和友好的 GUI/CLI 界面，支持多平台运行且无广告、无联网，是强大的系统清理与维护工具。
repos.summary_en: Czkawka is a fast, memory-safe Rust utility for finding and removing clutter like duplicate files, empty folders, similar images, and temporary files. Offering multiplatform support, efficient multithreading, cache scanning, and both GUI and CLI frontends, it provides a private, ad-free system cleaning solution.

repos.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件
repos.summary_zh: LX Music移动版是基于React Native与Redux的开源音乐播放器，支持Android，允许自定义音频源并具备数据同步功能。采用Apache 2.0协议，适合追求个性化的音乐爱好者。
repos.summary_en: LX Music Mobile is an open-source music player application developed with React Native and Redux, offering a highly customizable experience for Android users. The app supports custom audio sources, enabling users to pull streaming links from various providers, and includes an optional data synchronization service for multi-device compatibility. Licensed under Apache 2.0, it is designed for music enthusiasts who prioritize flexibility and personalization over out-of-the-box simplicity. The project maintains active development on the dev branch, with regular releases and community contributions welcome.

repos.description: 一个基于 Go 语言的全网音乐搜索与下载工具。支持 CLI 命令行与 Web 服务双模式，内置网易云、QQ、酷狗、Bilibili、汽水音乐等 10+ 个主流平台，支持多源并发搜索与无损音质解析。music-dl交流群：755087923
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Go 语言的多平台音乐搜索与无损下载工具，支持 Web、TUI 终端及桌面应用多模式运行。聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗等 10+ 主流平台，支持并发搜索、歌单解析与批量无损下载，提供本地歌单管理与扫码登录体验。
repos.summary_en: This is a powerful Go-based music search and lossless download tool supporting Web, TUI terminal, and desktop application modes. It aggregates over ten mainstream music platforms, offering concurrent search, playlist and album parsing, and high-quality batch downloads. Features include local playlist management, cookie-based login, and extensive lossless audio format support for superior playback quality.

repos.description: LX Music 数据同步服务端，同时支持了部分lx-music-desktop的网页端实现。
repos.summary_zh: LX Music增强型数据同步服务端，集成全能Web播放器，支持多源聚合搜索、本地音乐库深度管理、多平台歌单同步及个性化主题定制，提供无缝的跨端音乐同步与网页播放体验。
repos.summary_en: LX Music sync server with built-in web player, multi-source search, local library management, and cross-platform synchronization.

repos.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个基于 React Native 的跨平台音乐播放器，聚合网易云、QQ、酷狗等多平台音乐资源，支持自定义音源插件、主题美化、本地音乐管理及 WebDAV 同步，具备小爱音箱推送等智能联动功能，适用于个人多平台音乐播放与管理。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a cross-platform music player based on React Native, aggregating music from multiple platforms like NetEase, QQ, and Kugou. It supports custom audio source plugins, theme customization, local music management, WebDAV sync, and Xiao Ai speaker integration for smart home use, ideal for personal multi-platform music playback and management.

repos.description: 基于 React + Capacitor 的免费音乐 App，支持多音源搜索、网易云登录、主流平台歌单导入，以及 B 站音源搜索播放，安装包仅 2.5 MB。基于 GD Studio's Online Music Platform API。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 React 与 Capacitor 的超轻量多源聚合音乐播放器，支持多音源搜索、主流歌单导入及 B 站播放。安装包仅 2.5 MB，兼具 PWA 与原生移动端体验，并提供智能音源回退与数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Otter Music is a lightweight, multi-source aggregated music player built with React and Capacitor. Supporting extensive platform searches, playlist imports, and Bilibili playback within a tiny 2.5 MB package, it delivers near-native mobile and PWA experiences, featuring smart audio source fallback and seamless data synchronization.

repos.description: 星海音乐源 | LX Music 自定义音源插件，聚合 GDAPI/ChKSz API，支持酷我加密音频解密（需自行配置）
repos.summary_zh: 星海音乐源是一款针对LX Music的自定义音源插件，聚合了GDAPI等多平台接口以获取高品质音乐；其核心亮点在于支持通过自建服务器实时解密酷我加密音频，大幅扩展了桌面应用的音乐资源覆盖与播放体验。
repos.summary_en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom music source plugin for LX Music, aggregating APIs from multiple platforms to provide high-quality audio formats. Its key highlight is supporting self-deployed decryption servers to real-time decrypt and play Kuwo's encrypted audio, significantly expanding the music resource coverage and playback experience for desktop applications.

repos.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Hono.js 的 LX Music 数据同步服务，通过 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects 实现有状态 WebSocket 实时同步。无需自托管服务器，支持多用户隔离、快照合并与增量同步，一键部署，适用于多设备歌单与偏好同步。
repos.summary_en: An LX Music data sync service built on Hono.js, leveraging Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects for stateful WebSocket real-time sync. Serverless deployment with multi-user isolation, snapshot merging, incremental sync, and one-click deployment. Ideal for syncing playlists and preferences across devices.
